notes: Create Mod builds required mod folder structure.
Save To Mod duplicates existing game assets into ModOverride for the active mod.
Package Mod is run through Manage Mod.
ModOverride assets must preserve the original folder structure.
Copied custom DataTables can live in mod content when affected assets are pointed at them.
